title: Shop Assistant & Stock Records
description: Created for my spaza shop to make daily product recording easier. Records costs, quantities and selling prices, calculates product margins, flags low stock and exports Excel summaries.
purpose: Make small-shop records easier to capture and review, with useful stock and margin information in one place.
features: Product entry, search and an overview of recorded stock.
Cost and selling-price calculations, low-stock checks and profit charts.
Excel exports and a database backup function.
note: A Python desktop application. The repository includes the application source and a Windows installer configuration.

title: Customer Shopping Behaviour Analysis
description: A guided retail analytics project covering data preparation, customer analysis and dashboard reporting. This repository is my fork of Amlan Mohanty’s learning project.
purpose: Explore how an analyst turns shopping data into questions about customer segments, purchase patterns and loyalty.
features: A Python notebook for data exploration and preparation.
SQL queries for customer and purchasing analysis.
A Power BI dashboard, written report and presentation.
note: Learning focus: understanding and reproducing the full analysis workflow. The original project is credited below.

title: Mathematics of Finance Study App
description: An interactive MAT442 revision tool combining finance notes with calculators for interest, annuities, loan repayment and bond pricing. Also includes probability and stochastic-process material.
purpose: Bring finance revision notes, worked concepts and interactive calculations into one browser-based study resource.
features: Interest and annuity calculations.
Loan amortisation schedules and bond-pricing inputs.
Topic-based revision content for financial mathematics.
note: An educational revision resource with topic navigation and interactive calculation examples.

title: Spam Detection & Data Science Practice
description: Explores text classification using TF–IDF, Naive Bayes and logistic regression. Includes message-cleaning notebooks and datasets for introductory data-science exercises.
purpose: Practise turning raw message text into features that a machine-learning model can use to distinguish spam from ordinary messages.
features: Message cleaning and exploratory word and sentence counts.
TF–IDF text features and classification experiments.
Additional datasets covering advertising, Iris, unemployment and car data.
note: An exploratory notebook project focused on text preparation, feature extraction and classification.

title: Student Residence Billing Interface
description: A student-residence interface covering applications, room information and billing details, with separate student and administrator screens. Includes requirements and system-design documents.
purpose: Explore how students and residence administrators could manage accommodation information and view payment details.
features: Student application, profile and room-information screens.
Administrative screens for rooms, students and records.
Billing interface plus requirements and design documentation.
note: The public files demonstrate the front-end interface and system design. Backend billing integration remains a next step.

title: MyStudyApp — Course Notes & Questions
description: A study platform documented around user accounts, courses, notes and questions. The repository contains a project archive and a guide to setting up the Flask application.
purpose: Organise learning content around courses and sections so students can find notes and questions in a structured place.
features: The README describes registration and sign-in routes.
Course, section, notes and questions endpoints are documented.
Database-migration setup and offline-caching behaviour are explained.
note: The project is distributed as a ZIP archive with a README covering setup, database migrations and offline caching.

title: Sakhelwe — Inventory & Loan Management
description: An ongoing business-system project for chicken and pig stock, customer loans and monthly cash reporting. The public repository currently documents the business requirements.
purpose: Connect stock records, delivery notes, receipts and customer histories so the business can review its daily operations.
features: Planned stock and customer-loan records.
Planned delivery notes, receipts and transaction histories.
Planned cash tracking and monthly profit reporting.
note: Public development stage: business requirements documented; application source is still to be published.

title: Sikhwama Health — Django Foundation
description: The initial Django structure for Sikhwama Health, organised into core and health apps. The public models and views are starter files awaiting application features.

title: Django Authentication Practice
description: A practice project exploring registration, sign-in, form handling and Django authentication. Includes page templates and draft authentication views, with further work needed on the flows.

title: Education Platform Landing Page
description: A landing-page exercise for an education platform, with a styled welcome section and a registration call to action. Focuses on page layout rather than a complete learning system.

title: Eswatini Website Practice
description: An early website exercise centred on Eswatini. The files include a main page, an economy page and a login-page design, exploring navigation, images and Bootstrap layouts.

title: Unordered Array List in C++
description: An array-based list exercise with insert, delete, empty/full checks and data display. Uses separate header, implementation and application files to practise C++ structure.

title: Finance Study App — Alternate Version
description: Another version of the MAT442 mathematics-of-finance study app, bringing together revision content, interest calculations, amortisation and bond-pricing examples.

title: Personal Portfolio Website
description: My portfolio brings together software examples, skills linked to projects and a searchable catalogue of public repositories, with light and dark themes.

title: Command-Line Task Tracker
description: A specification for a command-line tool to add, update, delete and filter tasks, with progress states stored in JSON. The public repository currently contains the project outline.

title: UNESWA Voting System
description: A repository started for a university voting-system idea. Its published content currently consists of a README title; the application implementation has not yet been added.

title: Automated Savings Account Concept
description: A repository named for an online savings-account project with automated functions. No source files are currently published in this public repository.

title: Portfolio Development Workspace
description: A workspace intended for a data-analysis and full-stack-development portfolio. This repository currently has no published implementation; the active portfolio is in mpumelelo810.github.io.

title: Linked List Exercise
description: A repository named for a linked-list programming exercise. Source files have not yet been published.

title: Introduction to HTML
description: A GitHub Learning Lab repository for HTML fundamentals. Its published files contain the introductory course README and licence.

title: Markdown Portfolio Practice
description: A learning exercise for communicating with Markdown and preparing a simple portfolio. Contains a Markdown index, site configuration and GitHub course instructions.

title: GitHub Actions Learning Lab
description: An introductory GitHub course repository about actions and workflow files. The public content currently includes the course instructions and licence.

title: GitHub Profile Configuration
description: A workspace intended for GitHub profile configuration. No configuration files have been added yet.

title: Personal Repository Workspace
description: An empty public repository. No project functionality is described until source files or documentation are added.
